Section Header:
Research Group Name
"Research Groups" is a generic term used to refer to the universities, study sites, countries, regions, or other organizations that make up a Consortium. Complete one copy of this REDCap form for each Research Group participating in the Consortium.
Field Label:
Research Group primary name (short name)
(e.g. CCASAnet, NA-ACCORD)

Research Group full name
Write out long name, no abbreviations (e.g. Caribbean, Central and South America network for HIV Epidemiology, North American AIDS Cohort Collaboration on Research and Design)

Research Group short code
A short code for each research group is needed for Hub display purposes. (e.g. CN, NA)

Is this an Active Research Group in the Consortium?
(Use this to indicate current research groups vs. those that have left or been dropped from the Consortium.)

Should this Research Group be listed in the main interface?
(This can be used to exclude groups such as a Testing group from the Consortium Metrics.)

Will this Research Group participate in voting?
Only these Research Groups will appear on the voting dashboard. Active groups that do not participate in voting could include a funding agency group, or a Hub Testing group.

What order should this Research Group appear in on the voting dashboard?
Use numbers (decimals ok) to define the order of Research Groups on the main voting grid. You can use this feature to override the default alphabetical order and place a certain group at the beginning or end.
